Run from the repository root. Writes the atoms jsonl in place; prints what moved."""
import glob, json, re, subprocess, sys
H = "workplan/pipeline-state-graph/"
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, H + "build_graph.py", "--check"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
bad = re.findall(r"^FAIL\s+(\S+): quote found in (\S+) but not near cited line (\d+)", out, re.M)
norm = lambda s: re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
strip = lambda x: re.sub(r"^\s*>\s?", "", x)
files = {f: open(f, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n") for f in glob.glob(H + "atoms/atoms-*.jsonl")}
moved = []
for aid, path, ln in bad:
    ln = int(ln); lines = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
    for f, rows in files.items():
        for k, row in enumerate(rows):
            if not row.strip(): continue
            d = json.loads(row)
            if d["id"] != aid: continue
            head = norm(strip(d["quote"]))[:50]; probe = head[:25]
            cands = [L for L in range(1, len(lines) + 1)
                     if probe in norm(strip(lines[L - 1])) or (norm(strip(lines[L - 1])) and head.startswith(norm(strip(lines[L - 1]))[:25]) and len(norm(strip(lines[L - 1]))) >= 10)]
            cands = [L for L in cands if head in norm("\n".join(strip(x) for x in lines[max(0, L - 4):L + 3]))]
            if not cands: print("NO CANDIDATE", aid, path); continue
            new = min(cands, key=lambda L: abs(L - ln))
            rows[k] = row.replace(f'"source": "{d["source"]}"', f'"source": "{path}:{new}"', 1)
            moved.append((aid, ln, new))
for f, rows in files.items():
    open(f, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(rows))
print("re-anchored:", moved)
